articles.mainIdea: PayPal Text Payments Push Tests Valuation Discount And Growth Hopes
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: PayPal Text Payments Push Tests Valuation Discount And Growth Hopes. PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS:PYPL) has partnered with Authvia to enable payments directly through text and RCS messaging. The integration allows consumers to pay via SMS and RCS without downloading an app or visiting a website. Merchants can use the new capability across billing, service interactions and call centers to collect secure payments in real time. articles.summary: Benzinga: Trump Ally David Sacks Says US 'One Step Closer' To 'Crypto Capital' As Senate Panel Advances Bill. The U.S. Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry voted on Thursday to advance cryptocurrency market structure legislation, moving the bill closer to establishing federal regulations for digital assets. The move has been lauded by prominent figures in the industry, who see it as a vital step in positioning the U.S. as a global leader in crypto innovation.
